## Security and privacy

- [ ] Fixtures, screenshots and logs contain only fictional or reserved data.

- [ ] Dashboard and MCP behavior remains read-only, or the new trust boundary is explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] Deployment still defaults to loopback or another private boundary.
